title: Erasing the appended bit
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and bit $b$, changing the tape that stores $w$ followed by $b$ so that the cell indexed by $|w|$ is blank gives exactly the tape that stores $w$.
replaced: For every word $w$ and bit $b$, updating the buffer tape of $w$ extended by $b$ at cell $|w|$ with a blank yields exactly the buffer tape of $w$.
